theme: An open day — the holiday bookings need a push.
greeting: The calendar's completely clear today, Dan, no meetings to work around. The real pressure is a couple of holiday bookings that have slipped past their deadlines, while the Toronto panel quietly comes together for next week.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: p1 on the Mike + Dan board and overdue since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest, fastest-selling rental in that market, and the Pathfinder is south for the winter. A refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by Sept 30 and book-by Oct 15 have both passed. Six people across three weeks over the holidays is the year's thinnest inventory. The board's default is a domestic shortlist unless someone wants international.

needsAttention.title: Term life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: p2 and overdue since Sept 25: four kids and no coverage. Your side is the shopping, quotes, term length, coverage amount. Still need a target coverage figure and term to start.

flagged.title: Toronto panel firming up for next week
flagged.detail: On your ICGN Plenary 7 thread, Jane and Andy signed off on your run of show; Rachit is still finalizing questions with the ICGN team. The conference is Nov 4-5 in Toronto.

flagged.title: Two roles landed in your alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged Executive Director, Corporate Strategy at Estee Lauder and a Managing Partner opening at Synergy Management Group.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters, retail sale emails, and travel promos.

recipe.title: Warm beet soup
recipe.why: Autumn roots are at their sweetest now, and a warm beet soup makes the most of the season's earthy harvest.

tasks.title: Portland house order, king bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: A clear calendar all morning, nothing booked.
The open stretch runs right through the afternoon.
Home in St. Pete with the girls under the roof, an easy close.
